notes: Workshop, neon-ish: a round vat of nanite paste in a navy-violet cradle with a cyan glass rim. The paste carries a four-arm swirl of bright nanites that turns a quarter-arm per... (4 frames = a quarter turn of a four-fold swirl, so it loops cleanly); four feed pipes with violet lamps. Damaged: the glass is cracked and paste weeps out onto the cradle, the swirl stutters. Disabled: the vat is dry and dull, the glass shattered, paste dried round the crack.
